plugins.name: airgap-anything
plugins.description: Agent skills for air-gapped environments: airgap-architect designs the system and lists what to carry in; airgap-transfer packs that list into a bundle that checks itself inside; airgap-agent sets up coding agents for the network without internet; airgap-rag makes your documents searchable inside it; airgap-install writes the deployment files and a runbook to install the design inside.
